verdict.rationale: Docs strongly support headless/CI use: hosting guide covers Docker/Kubernetes deployment, subprocess architecture, scaling, and observability, plus programmatic Python/TS clients, structured JSON outputs, and permission callbacks suited to automation (claude-agent-sdk-docs-11, -20, -13, -10, -6). However, community reports describe real friction running it headlessly in practice ('claude -p'): policy changes restricting subscription use for headless/automation workflows, poor observability/DX ('garbage harness', 'no extensibility'), and users migrating away amid uncertainty (claude-agent-sdk-comm-1, -4, -5, -6, -9, -11), even though others confirm building working headless CI pipelines (claude-agent-sdk-comm-7).
